propositions: Define immutable operation/outcome values with canonical UUID logical_id, Disposition, FailureScope, ReplaySafety, and DelaySource enums to create a provider-neutral logical-operation contract

Implement a fake-clock retry budget owner in the reconciler domain permitting at most 3 physical invocations and 15,000 ms cumulative sleep with zero-based retry indexes mapping to [2s,3s) and [4s,5s) sleep windows

Enforce diagnostic entry allowlist (stage, category, status_code, provider_code, retry_after_ms, message only) with message redaction via sanitize_diagnostic seam and 512 code-point truncation, bounded to at most 8 entries with sentinel overflow entry
Guarantee canonical byte-identical sorted-key UTF-8 JSON serialization for equivalent outcomes via rebar._store.canonical.canonical_bytes

After ambiguous commit, observe desired primary-store postcondition before replay; observed desired state produces recovered, while failed or inconclusive observation produces non-replaying commit_unknown with ReplaySafety.forbidden
For over-budget provider delays, return retry_not_before without sleeping or incrementing invocation/request totals, preserving authoritative provider delays as sleep lower bounds
